Widget family: SCROLLBAR

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A scrollbar sits along one edge (vertical or horizontal as claimed).
2. A distinct thumb/knob shorter than that edge is visible.
3. The gutter/track behind the thumb may be subtle or close to the panel color —
   do not FAIL only because the track is low-contrast.
4. Thumb position roughly matches the claimed scroll fraction (start / middle / end).
5. FAIL if: no thumb, thumb spans the entire edge (looks like a solid bar only), or scrollbar is missing while content is claimed to overflow.
